name: Miura 1
tagline: PLD Space's suborbital demonstrator: one flight in October 2023, 46 km up
description: Miura 1 is the suborbital demonstrator of PLD Space, a Spanish company: 12.7 m tall, 2,550 kg, with a TEPREL-B engine of 30.2 kN, designed to lift 100 kg to about 150 km. On 2023-10-07 at 00:19 UTC (02:19 CEST) it launched from El Arenosillo, in Huelva, and flew for about 306 s. It reached 46 km, not the 80 km planned: the apogee was lowered for range safety, which gave a flatter trajectory. It splashed down in the Atlantic under parachute and then sank, probably after water leaked into the fuel tank, and was not recovered. No second flight has been found.
best_known_for: PLD Space's suborbital demonstrator: one flight on 2023-10-07, 46 km up
